headline: SHORT ORDER SHOUT goes full co-op: seat control + live voice
lede: Slot b closed out the SOS online-polish era: the final stage (host demote/promote chips and voice production) shipped on slot a, and the feedback-replay harness landed on main, so a filed phone report can now be re-driven as real key events on the tick grid.

notes.text: FEEDBACKREPLAY merged (#1466): a filed report is shape-gated and re-driven against the live game as real key events on the tick grid, with zero-page-error and sim-progress gates.

Two machine-local gh-shim bugs found and fixed — --paginate swallowed the API path, and --jq quoted string scalars, which silently wedged the rule-5 merge loop forever. That loop is exactly where the last lane died; it now runs verbatim.

Flagship backlog audit: every Honest gap in SSX, Emberwood, COMET DRIFT HD and Myst READMEs is now owned or closed — the builder ladder is genuinely empty; #1456 asks Jon what to self-commission next.
